goals.name: PR Preparation Session Goal Harness
goals.description: PR Preparation Session Goal Harness [code-pr-prep-session] — compiled from capabilities/harnesses/hA-08-code-pr-prep.yaml
goals.gate: All gates passed or degraded-with-log; zero unresolved halt gates

gates.name: 0.1 Startup phrase spoken and the PR pinned to branch name + bas
gates.description: Startup phrase spoken and the PR pinned to branch name + base branch + linked issue/ticket ID
gates.command: Session log contains branch, base, and issue reference; git branch --show-current matches

gates.name: 0.2 Procedures declared mandatory: self-review before push, desc
gates.description: Procedures declared mandatory: self-review before push, description from the diff not from memory, CI green or explained, reviewer-ready
gates.command: All four procedure names in session preamble

gates.name: 0.3 RIG coordinate stated before the first self-review command
gates.description: RIG coordinate stated before the first self-review command
gates.command: Session log line 'COORD: L2-L4 x D1-D2 x A1/A2 x IQRSQPI'

gates.name: 0.4 Harness tuple H_prprep(branch_hygiene, self_review, descript
gates.description: Harness tuple H_prprep(branch_hygiene, self_review, description_pack, ci_green, improvement) declared
gates.command: Tuple declaration present in session log

gates.name: 1.1 Branch is current: rebased/merged onto latest base (git fetc
gates.description: Branch is current: rebased/merged onto latest base (git fetch && git log base..HEAD sanity) with conflicts resolved, and the branch contains only commits belonging to this change
gates.command: git merge-base HEAD origin/<base> equals origin/<base> tip, or divergence is explained; git log --oneline origin/<base>..HEAD attached to .rig/pr/commits.txt

gates.name: 1.2 No stray artifacts in the diff: no debug prints, commented-o
gates.description: No stray artifacts in the diff: no debug prints, commented-out code, .env files, editor droppings, or unintended files; git status clean except intended changes
gates.command: grep -rnE '(console\.log|print\(|TODO: temp|FIXME: temp)' over changed files empty or justified; git status --porcelain attached

gates.name: 1.3 Commit hygiene: commit messages follow repo convention (conv
gates.description: Commit hygiene: commit messages follow repo convention (conventional commits or existing style), each commit is self-contained, and WIP/fixup commits are squashed
gates.command: git log output in .rig/pr/commits.txt shows no WIP/fixup! subjects; convention exemplar from recent main history cited

gates.name: 2.1 Full-diff self-review executed: git diff origin/<base>...HEA
gates.description: Full-diff self-review executed: git diff origin/<base>...HEAD read end-to-end and a per-hunk verdict recorded (ok / fixed-this-session / flagged-for-reviewer)
gates.command: .rig/pr/self-review.md exists; every changed file from --stat appears with at least one verdict line

gates.name: 2.2 Tests and verification evidence attached: suite, typecheck,
gates.description: Tests and verification evidence attached: suite, typecheck, lint run on the exact HEAD to be pushed (not an older tree)
gates.command: Three exit codes + HEAD SHA in .rig/pr/verify.txt; SHA matches git rev-parse HEAD at push time

gates.name: 2.3 Risk surface named: the 1-3 riskiest hunks (schema change, a
gates.description: Risk surface named: the 1-3 riskiest hunks (schema change, auth path, concurrency, deletion) are explicitly flagged for reviewers with file:line and why
gates.command: self-review.md 'Risk Flags' section; empty requires a one-line 'low-risk diff because <reason>'

gates.name: 3.1 PR description written from the diff: summary (what+why), ch
gates.description: PR description written from the diff: summary (what+why), change list mapped to files, test plan with the actual commands run, and issue linkage (Closes #N)
gates.command: .rig/pr/DESCRIPTION.md contains all four sections; every command in test plan appears in verify.txt

gates.name: 3.2 Visual proof for UI changes: before/after screenshots or a s
gates.description: Visual proof for UI changes: before/after screenshots or a short capture attached for any diff touching rendered components/styles
gates.command: Screenshot paths in .rig/pr/visuals/ referenced from DESCRIPTION.md, or a 'no UI surface' line justified by the diff file list

gates.name: 3.3 Migration/rollout notes when applicable: DB migrations, env
gates.description: Migration/rollout notes when applicable: DB migrations, env var changes, and config changes each get a rollout + rollback line
gates.command: DESCRIPTION.md 'Rollout' section present when the diff touches migrations/, .env.example, or config; otherwise explicitly 'N/A — no ops surface'

gates.name: 4.1 CI green or explained: after push (or dry-run), CI status ch
gates.description: CI green or explained: after push (or dry-run), CI status checked (gh pr checks / gh run list) and any red job has a root-cause note, not a shrug
gates.command: gh pr checks output in .rig/pr/ci.txt; red jobs each have a cause line in the session tail

gates.name: 4.2 Improvement entry written: one thing that would have caught
gates.description: Improvement entry written: one thing that would have caught an issue earlier (hook, template, check) or one harness gap

preconditions.startup_phrase: I review my own diff before anyone else has to.
preconditions.bms_bias: A1 for self-review and CI; A2 for description writing; A3 for summary prose; A4 only for the push itself with explicit human instruction

self_improvement.update_trigger: same gate fails 3+ times → promote to a pre-push hook or PR template field

success_conditions: All gates passed or degraded-with-log; zero unresolved halt gates
DESCRIPTION.md complete with real test-plan commands and issue linkage
CI status captured; reds explained or none
Identity closure: coordinate, PR-readiness verdict, next safe action stated
failure_states: the push itself is an outward action — execute only on explicit human instruction; everything up to push is in-scope
halt gate(s) 1.1, 1.2, 2.1, 2.2, 3.1, 3.3, 4.1, 4.2: no progress without gate evidence
quality_criteria: Startup phrase spoken and the PR pinned to branch name + base branch + linked issue/ticket ID
Procedures declared mandatory: self-review before push, description from the diff not from memory, CI green or explained, reviewer-ready
RIG coordinate stated before the first self-review command
Harness tuple H_prprep(branch_hygiene, self_review, description_pack, ci_green, improvement) declared
Branch is current: rebased/merged onto latest base (git fetch && git log base..HEAD sanity) with conflicts resolved, and the branch contains only commits belonging to this change
No stray artifacts in the diff: no debug prints, commented-out code, .env files, editor droppings, or unintended files; git status clean except intended changes
Commit hygiene: commit messages follow repo convention (conventional commits or existing style), each commit is self-contained, and WIP/fixup commits are squashed
Full-diff self-review executed: git diff origin/<base>...HEAD read end-to-end and a per-hunk verdict recorded (ok / fixed-this-session / flagged-for-reviewer)
Tests and verification evidence attached: suite, typecheck, lint run on the exact HEAD to be pushed (not an older tree)
Risk surface named: the 1-3 riskiest hunks (schema change, auth path, concurrency, deletion) are explicitly flagged for reviewers with file:line and why
PR description written from the diff: summary (what+why), change list mapped to files, test plan with the actual commands run, and issue linkage (Closes #N)
Visual proof for UI changes: before/after screenshots or a short capture attached for any diff touching rendered components/styles
Migration/rollout notes when applicable: DB migrations, env var changes, and config changes each get a rollout + rollback line
CI green or explained: after push (or dry-run), CI status checked (gh pr checks / gh run list) and any red job has a root-cause note, not a shrug
Improvement entry written: one thing that would have caught an issue earlier (hook, template, check) or one harness gap

final_rule: The diff is re-read before it is shown.
The test plan contains commands that were actually run.
Red CI gets a cause, not a shrug.
No improvement entry, no session complete.
Every code-pr-prep session leaves the system stronger than it found it.

failure_protocol.notes: the push itself is an outward action — execute only on explicit human instruction; everything up to push is in-scope
